domain_restrictions: S is identified with the rational numbers as a ring in the case d=0
semantic_sketch_json.normalized_claim: If A and B are integers with A at least B and B at least 0, and if d equals 0, then Q_{A,B,0}(q) equals 1; the weighted polynomial ring S equals Q; the empty sequence of elements of S is a homogeneous regular sequence; the quotient by that empty sequence is S itself; and the Hilbert series of S is 1.

variables.role: parameter in Q_{A,B,d} and indexing the construction of the weighted polynomial ring

variables.name: B
variables.role: parameter in Q_{A,B,d} and indexing the construction of the weighted polynomial ring

variables.name: d
variables.role: specialization parameter; the statement fixes d to be 0

variables.domain: unspecified; typically a formal variable for generating functions
variables.name: q

variables.domain: unspecified codomain (given as 1 in the case d=0)
variables.name: Q_{A,B,d}(q)
variables.role: quantity determined by A,B,d evaluated at q

variables.domain: the rational numbers viewed as a ring
variables.name: S
variables.role: weighted polynomial ring constructed from the parameters; in this case it equals Q

statement_nl: Let A,B be integers with A >= B >= 0. For d=0 one has Q_{A,B,0}(q)=1, the weighted polynomial ring is S=Q, and the empty sequence of elements of S is a homogeneous regular sequence. Its quotient is S itself, whose Hilbert series is 1.
